text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday, reduced to two newspapers because of Moslem Eid el Fitr holiday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria on Saturday celebrates Eid el Fitr feast marking the end of the holy Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
- The authorities step up preparations for the parliamentary elections planned for the first half of this year.
- President Liamine Zeroual writes to leaders of the United Nations, the Organisation of African Unity and the Arab League asking them to dispatch observers to supervise Algerian general elections.
